title: 店铺目标进度
query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：查询2026年8月1日至22日每日店铺指标的GMV合计最高的5家店铺，返回店铺名称、该期间GMV、8月月度GMV目标和完成率，完成率为实际除以目标，保留4位小数。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: WITH store_gmv AS (SELECT d.store_id, SUM(d.gmv) AS period_gmv FROM daily_store_metrics d WHERE d.stat_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND d.stat_date <= DATE '2026-08-22' GROUP BY d.store_id), aug_target AS (SELECT t.store_id, SUM(t.gmv_target) AS gmv_target FROM sales_targets t WHERE t.target_month = '2026-08' GROUP BY t.store_id) SELECT s.store_name AS "店铺名称", ROUND(g.period_gmv, 2) AS "该期间GMV", ROUND(t.gmv_target, 2) AS "8月月度GMV目标", ROUND(g.period_gmv / NULLIF(t.gmv_target, 0), 4) AS "完成率" FROM store_gmv g JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = g.store_id LEFT JOIN aug_target t ON t.store_id = g.store_id ORDER BY g.period_gmv DESC LIMIT 5
result.analysis: 该结果展示了2026年8月1日至8月22日GMV最高的5家店铺，其中星选039店该期间GMV为1883869.4，星选057店完成率为8.203。
